messages:
Sara Chen (AE): Heads-up — GhostChain sent their RFI this morning. They want a capability matrix + concise answers on compute profile, latency SLOs, and KMS/HSM options. Can eng/sales-ops help pull numbers for the POC pricing tiers?

Rajeev Kapoor: I can take lead on the technical matrix. Quick q: are they expecting 8k or 32k context for the POC? That affects throughput numbers a lot.

Sara Chen (AE): They said 16k for most workloads, but embeddings + retrieval will use shorter contexts. POC target: 200 concurrent inference streams, 50k embed calls/day.

Marta Li: From security: they flagged FIPS/HSM for key isolation. We'll need to confirm what our Private deployment + HSM add-on covers and what we can state in the RFI. I have a checklist to attach.

Rajeev Kapoor: OK. Draft matrix snippet below — use for the RFI table. Need someone to sanity-check numbers and add pricing rows.

Rajeev Kapoor: ```
Capability | Hosted API | Dedicated (Reserved) | Private (VPC/HSM)
---------- | ---------- | -------------------- | -----------------
Context length | up to 32k (model dependent) | up to 32k | up to 32k
Latency (p50 gen, 16k) | 120-180 ms | 80-120 ms | 90-140 ms
Concurrent streams (per pool) | burst to 100s | predictable to 1000s | configurable
KV/prefix caching | automatic | automatic + tuned | automatic + tuned
HSM/KMS | cloud KMS | customer KMS integration | HSM-backed keys (add-on)
SLA | standard | SLA-backed (gold/plat) | enterprise SLA
```

Eli Morgan: Numbers look sensible. A couple notes: latency depends heavily on model variant + quantization. For the RFI, call out a range and note typical config: 16k context, bf16 or int8 quant. Also mention fallback policy: when Dedicated capacity exhausted we can route to Hosted w/ notice (optional).

Rajeev Kapoor: Good call. I'll add a short sentence about quant profiles. Also: Marta, can you confirm the phrasing for HSM support? They asked if we support customer-managed HSM and whether keys ever touch our control plane.

Marta Li: Short answer for RFI: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Dedicated and Private. For HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), we offer an add-on package on Private deployments; keys remain in the customer's HSM or in a vetted HSM-backed KMS. I'll paste the approved line: "Keys used for model encryption and audit logs can be kept in customer HSMs or HSM-backed KMS; Redwood control plane never receives plaintext keys."

Rajeev Kapoor: Perfect. Sara — pricing rows: need tiered POC pricing: hosted consumption estimate, 1-month dedicated reservation option (small pool), and private estimate with HSM add-on. Any existing template?

Sara Chen (AE): Use the POC pricing template in Drive: <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcd-POC-templates|GhostChain-RFI-Attachments>. For the quick reply: estimate hosted cost ~ $3.5k/day at their volume if unoptimized, but with caching/quantization we expect ~60% cost reduction -> ~ $1.4k/day. Dedicated 1-month commit: ~$75k incl. ops. Private w/ HSM: starting at ~$120k plus integration. I'll attach the numbers.

Rajeev Kapoor: I'll draft the RFI answers this afternoon and paste here. Also adding a short runbook for the POC acceptance criteria (latency p95 <= 500 ms for gen, embed 50ms p50).

deploy-bot: New file uploaded: GhostChain-RFI-Attachments v1 (drive link) :paperclip:

Marta Li: Security questionnaire quick answers: data residency = EU only (we can pin region), logs retention = configurable (default 30 days), SOC2/ISO reports = attached NDA-only. I'll mark any sections that need legal signoff.

Eli Morgan: One more detail to add to the matrix: model fallbacks. For cost control we can auto-route to smaller quantized variants when latency budget allows — call this out as an operational policy.

Sara Chen (AE): Great — team, can we aim to ship the RFI package to GhostChain by EOD tomorrow? Rajeev, take the matrix + draft answers; Marta, finalize security lines; Eli, a 1-paragraph ops note on fallbacks; I'll assemble pricing and send.

Rajeev Kapoor: On it. I'll post the first draft by 3pm PT.

Marta Li: Will do — I'll highlight legal items inline.

Eli Morgan: I'll hand you a short ops blurb by 2pm.

Sara Chen (AE): Thanks all :rocket:
